messages:
emily: heads-up: customer reported weird billing after a truncated toolcall retried mid-stream. UI showed a short negative adjustment then a positive — confusing for support. repro attached.
rahul: paste logs? curious if reconciler applied a compensating adjust out of order.
emily: logs:
```
2026-08-12T10:22:11.001Z [stream] session=svc-7 event=provisional tokens=180 tx=t-main
2026-08-12T10:22:11.120Z [toolcall] session=svc-7 call=kb_lookup event=provisional tokens=90 tx=t-tool-1
2026-08-12T10:22:11.300Z client=EOF -> server truncates response
2026-08-12T10:22:11.420Z [toolcall] session=svc-7 call=kb_lookup event=provisional tokens=30 tx=t-tool-2 (retry)
2026-08-12T10:22:11.600Z [ledger] confirm tx=t-main tokens=180
2026-08-12T10:22:11.610Z [ledger] confirm tx=t-tool-2 tokens=30
2026-08-12T10:22:11.612Z [ledger] adjust tx=t-tool-1 tokens=-90 // reconciler replaced t-tool-1 with t-tool-2
```
emily: UI rendered the adjust before the final confirm so support saw a -90 spike then +30 which looked like data loss.
ben: we discussed this pattern earlier. Ledger reconciler should emit a single reconciled_confirm event instead of a raw negative adjust plus separate confirm. That preserves causality in the timeline.
kay: agreed. also toolcall workers should attach retry_of=<orig_tx> when retrying so reconciler has lineage and can collapse without a negative delta.
rahul: short-term mitigation: buffer reconciliation emissions for ~200ms to let retries finish; then emit reconciled_confirm(canonical_tx, replaced=[...], net_tokens). UI can render that atomically.
ops-bot: billing alert created: unusual-reconcile session=svc-7 delta=-90
billing-bot: ticket BILL-XX1 opened: reconciler-event-metadata
ben: long-term: ledger API change to accept confirm with original_range & canonical_id, plus reconciler contract to never emit standalone negative adjusts for replaced provisonals — always emit a reconciled record.
kay: console change: group provisional -> confirm -> reconcile into one expandable timeline row, show worker/source and trace id. that will make support triage immediate.
emily: plan: I will open RFC with repro, propose reconciled_confirm event schema, and a small UI patch. rahul + ben to own reconciler PR. kay to prototype timeline UI.
rahul: I'll also add telemetry: reconciliation_count, reconciliation_negative_deltas, and an alert if negative_deltas > 0 after we ship the canary.
emily: thanks. attaching the repro harness to the RFC. ping me if you want to pair on the canary run. :thumbsup:
